content: संग्रहः .²1 Seizing, grasping; taking; प्रज्वाल्य तत्र चैवाग्निमकरोत् पाणिसंग्रहम् <ls>Rām. 7. 12. 20</ls>. .²2 Clenching the fist, grasp, grip. .²3 Reception, admission. .²4 Guarding, protection; तथा ग्रामशतानां च कुर्याद्राष्ट्रस्य संग्रहम् <ls>Ms. 7. 114</ls>. .²5 Favouring, propitiating, entertaining, supporting; धनैः कार्योऽस्य संग्रहः <ls>Ms. 3. 138</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">8. 311</ls>. .²6 Storing, accumulation, gathering, collecting; स्वधासंग्रहतत्पराः <ls>R. 1. 66</ls>; तैः कृतप्रकृतिसग्रहैः <ls n="R.">19. 55</ls>, <ls n="R.">17. 60</ls>. .²7 Governing, restraining, controlling; एष वै परमो योगो मनसः संग्रहः स्मृतः <ls>Bhāg. 11. 20. 21</ls>. .²8 Conglomeration. .²9 Conjunction. .²10 Agglomeration (a kind of संयोग). .²11 Inclusion, comprehension. .²12 Compilation. .²13 Epitome, summary, abridgment, compendium; संग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्यते <ls>Bg. 8. 11</ls>; so तकंसंग्रहः; मय्यावेशितया युक्त एतावान् योगसंग्रहः <ls>Bhāg. 11. 23. 61</ls>. .²14 Sum, amount, totality; करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कर्मसंग्रहः <ls>Bg. 18. 18</ls>. .²15 A catalogue, list. .²16 A store-room. .²17 An effort, exertion. .²18 Mention, reference. .²19 Greatness, elevation. .²20 Velocity. .²21 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²22 A guardian, ruler, manager; ततो निक्षिप्य काकुत्स्थो लक्ष्मणं द्वारि संग्रहम् <ls>Rām. 7. 103. 15</ls>. .²23 The fetching back of discharged weapons by magical means; <ls>Mb.</ls> .²24 Taking to wife, marriage. .²25 Perception, notion.
